verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents and exposes a full public API (JMAP) with autodiscovery via /.well-known/jmap, standard OAuth2/Bearer token auth, API token generation, and a public dev docs page; runtime probes confirm the endpoint is live, auth-gated, and standards-discoverable, making it genuinely drivable by an AI agent. Missing for 10: no dedicated llms.txt or OpenAPI spec for LLM-specific tooling (both probed as 404), and no first-party AI/agent integration examples.
